findings.fix: Give a plain timeframe, for example: "We'll send your proposal within about two weeks of getting your files." Then make the same change in all four group copies.

findings.problem: The subject text is 45 characters, which passes. But the whole line with the "Subject: " label is 54 characters. emails.md asks us to keep the whole line within 50 too, so a checker that counts the label would fail it.
findings.fix: Cut at least 4 characters, for example "Subject: How businesses like yours make money" (that's 45 characters as a whole line). Then make the same change in all four group copies.
